resources.string: Check native code and the latest capture diagnostics
Diagnostic AWB candidates; photo colour still uses Photon

The native button checks the recovered WB primitive. Each supported single RAW capture also records six experimental AWB acceptance settings in its capture JSON. These settings are not calibrated and do not change photo colour. The latest save and diagnostic status appears below.
Fixed to one RAW input frame for this development checkpoint. Photos use the existing Photon renderer.
